definition: Omit B2020-113, the compiler 46 cm Williams Lake Fen value. Johnson et al.1994 PNW-GTR-322 p.6 reports two Mazama horizons separated by9 cm lake sediment; the relationship of46 cm to individual beds remains unverified. This test assigns no replacement thickness, age or precursor identity.
